features.name: Establish repository harness
features.description: Create and validate restartable instructions, state, verification, scope, and lifecycle artifacts for local-agent development.
acceptance_criteria: AGENTS.md routes agents through the harness startup and end-of-session workflows.
feature_list.json, progress.md, init.sh, and session-handoff.md exist and agree on the active feature.
validate-harness reports a passing score and focused verification evidence is recorded.
The user reviews and approves the harness before feature code changes begin.
features.evidence: 2026-07-23: user approved the harness. validate-harness passed 100/100 (all five subsystems 5/5). ./init.sh: format check passed; local_agent_runtime tests passed (4 unit, 17 integration, 1 ignored doc test); Warp focused tests blocked before execution because the Xcode Metal Toolchain is not installed. init.sh now detects this prerequisite and prints the installation command.

features.name: Lossless supported-tool transcript restoration
features.description: Round-trip every locally supported tool call and result across persisted conversation history without dropping IDs, errors, cancellations, or route information.
acceptance_criteria: Built-in, edit_files, MCP tool/resource, and read_skill calls restore with matching call IDs and arguments.
Tool results preserve semantic content and error/cancel state.
Malformed historical pairs are omitted or repaired as a pair, never left orphaned.
Round-trip regression tests cover every registered local tool family.
features.evidence: 2026-07-23: Added a versioned canonical transcript envelope and centralized proto codec for built-ins, edit_files, MCP tools/resources, and skills. Exact generated MCP names, IDs, JSON arguments, result content, and error state round-trip. Orphaned historical pairs are filtered. Extended typed result persistence. Focused Warp tests passed: 29/29.

features.name: Context budget and compaction
features.description: Enforce a provider-facing context budget while preserving persisted history and tool-call/result pairing.
acceptance_criteria: Request context limits are propagated into RuntimeConfig.
System prompt, tool schemas, expected output, and conversation history share one explicit budget.
Old tool results and complete old turns compact without splitting call/result pairs.
Recent turns remain intact and impossible budgets fail with a structured error.
features.evidence: 2026-07-23: Propagated RequestParams.context_window_limit; reserved output and tool-schema budget; added pair-preserving complete-turn compaction with structured summaries, recent-turn preservation, and model-only tool-result compaction. Impossible budgets return ContextBudgetExceeded. local_agent_runtime tests passed: 24/24 plus 1 ignored doc test; focused Warp tests passed: 29/29.

features.name: Provider retry, continuation, and stall recovery
features.description: Make Ollama calls recover from bounded transient failures, context overflow, max-token termination, and repeated no-progress loops.
acceptance_criteria: Retryable provider failures use bounded cancellation-aware backoff.
Context overflow triggers compaction before one bounded retry.
Max-token responses continue without duplicating streamed output.
Repeated identical no-progress cycles stop with a structured reason.
The hard 10-turn integration cap is replaced by a documented safe policy.
features.evidence: 2026-07-23: Classified Ollama transient, rate-limit, timeout, model-not-found, and context-overflow failures. Added bounded cancellation-aware exponential retries, one context-tightening overflow retry, bounded max-token continuation, paired repeated-tool-call stall termination, and a 100-turn absolute safety ceiling. local_agent_runtime tests passed: 28/28 plus 1 ignored doc test. Local runtime clippy passed with -D warnings.

features.name: Resumable ask-user flow
features.description: Expose Warp's existing ask-user action to the local runtime and return structured answer, skip, cancel, and error results to the model.
acceptance_criteria: The tool is advertised only when ask-user is enabled and executable.
The runtime waits for the existing Warp UI action result.
Answer, skip, cancellation, and error outcomes preserve one call/result pair.
Bridge and executor tests cover all outcomes.
features.evidence: 2026-07-23: Added request-gated ask_user_question schema and mapped it to Warp's existing interactive AskUserQuestion action. Answered, skipped, auto-skipped, error, and cancellation outcomes return structured model results and persist through the transcript codec. Focused Warp tests passed.

features.name: Runtime permission modes and policy propagation
features.description: Add Default, AcceptEdits, and Plan modes without bypassing Warp's protected-path, organization, isolation, or risky-command policy.
acceptance_criteria: Permission mode semantics are exhaustive and documented.
Plan mode removes or denies mutating built-in and MCP schemas.
AcceptEdits never bypasses protected paths or risky shell policy.
Approval cancellation and resumed execution preserve one call/result pair.
features.evidence: 2026-07-23: Added Default, AcceptEdits, and Plan request modes. Plan mode removes mutating built-in and MCP schemas while retaining read-only tools and ask-user. Default and AcceptEdits continue through Warp's existing action UI, preserving protected-path, isolation, and risky-command policy.

features.name: Executable capability and prompt consistency
features.description: Derive local prompt capabilities from the same tool registry used for execution so enabled settings are never presented as unavailable tools.
acceptance_criteria: Prompt and runtime use one registry snapshot per request.
Planning, web, computer, research, and orchestration are not advertised without matching schemas.
Active MCP and skill tools are described accurately.
Focused prompt tests prevent registry/prompt drift.
features.evidence: 2026-07-23: The runtime and prompt now consume the same request-scoped LocalRuntimeToolRegistry snapshot. Prompt output lists only executable schemas, includes permission mode, and explicitly marks planning/web/computer/research/orchestration unavailable without matching schemas. Focused prompt/bridge tests passed.

features.name: Phase A reliability gate
features.description: Run automated and manual parity checks against a pinned Ollama model and context window before beginning autonomy work.
acceptance_criteria: All focused tests, formatting, and relevant clippy checks pass.
A run with at least 15 tool calls completes without orphaned results or context overflow.
Manual read, edit, shell, search, ask-user, denial, cancellation, and resume prompts pass on the pinned model.
Failures and follow-up features are recorded with evidence.
features.evidence: 2026-07-23: Phase A gate passed: harness 100/100, format and git diff checks, local_agent_runtime 29 automated tests, focused Warp local_runtime 32 tests, and local_agent_runtime clippy with -D warnings. Live parity passed over SSH to bcl-2 using Ollama 0.20.2, qwen3-coder:latest, and its 262144-token context: 15 sequential real model tool calls completed in 9.64s with exact pairing. Full Warp clippy remains independently blocked by two pre-existing warpui_core unnecessary_unwrap findings; cold macOS builds still require the Xcode Metal Toolchain.
